name: knowledge_spaces
postconditions: SELECT current_user ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,20}_owner$' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname=ANY(ARRAY['assistant','gateway','knowledge']) AND pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner)<>current_user) AND (SELECT count(*)=3 FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname=ANY(ARRAY['assistant','gateway','knowledge'])) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=current_user AND (r.rolcanlogin OR r.rolsuper OR r.rolcreatedb OR r.rolcreaterole OR r.rolreplication OR r.rolbypassrls))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='knowledge' AND c.relname='spaces' AND c.relkind='r' AND pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)=current_user) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='knowledge' AND c.relname='space_items' AND c.relkind='r' AND pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)=current_user) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='knowledge' AND c.relname='space_item_revisions' AND c.relkind='r' AND pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)=current_user) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='knowledge' AND c.relname='space_members' AND c.relkind='r' AND pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)=current_user) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='knowledge' AND c.relname='space_item_shares' AND c.relkind='r' AND pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)=current_user) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='knowledge' AND c.relname='space_item_stars' AND c.relkind='r' AND pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)=current_user) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='knowledge' AND c.relname='space_item_activity' AND c.relkind='r' AND pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)=current_user)

SELECT pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(left(current_user, length(current_user)-length('owner'))||'knowledge_api', 'knowledge.spaces', 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE') AND NOT pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(left(current_user, length(current_user)-length('owner'))||'knowledge_api', 'knowledge.spaces', 'DELETE') AND NOT pg_catalog.has_table_privilege('public', 'knowledge.spaces', 'SELECT')
